   1| ## 3. Containers
   2| 
   3| Larkspur WMS runs the warehouse floor of one site. This section lists its containers, the calls
   4| between them and the limits that apply. Slotting service is added by this task; every other
   5| container exists today. The two client apps are the Handheld app and the Supervisor console. The
   6| Larkspur team writes the four services; the API gateway and the Event bus are off-the-shelf
   7| products.
   8| 
   9| ### 3.1 Containers
  10| 
  11| | Container | Technology | Zone | Owns |
  12| | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
  13| | Handheld app | Android app, used by floor operators | — | — |
  14| | Supervisor console | web app, used by shift supervisors | — | — |
  15| | API gateway | Kong | DMZ | — |
  16| | Inventory service | Java service | application zone | Inventory DB |
  17| | Picking service | Java service | application zone | Picking DB |
  18| | Slotting service | Python service | application zone | — |
  19| | Label printer bridge | Go service | application zone | — |
  20| | Event bus | RabbitMQ | application zone | — |
  21| | Inventory DB | MariaDB | data zone | — |
  22| | Picking DB | MariaDB | data zone | — |
  23| | Reporting replica | MariaDB, read-only | data zone | — |
  24| 
  25| ### 3.2 Calls
  26| 
  27| Every client call enters through the API gateway.
  28| 
  29| | Caller | Callee | Protocol | Purpose |
  30| | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
  31| | Handheld app | API gateway | HTTPS | pick tasks and scans |
  32| | Supervisor console | API gateway | HTTPS | stock and pick reports |
  33| | API gateway | Inventory service | gRPC | stock queries |
  34| | API gateway | Picking service | gRPC | pick tasks |
  35| | Picking service | Inventory service | gRPC | reserve stock, synchronous |
  36| | Picking service | Label printer bridge | gRPC | print label |
  37| | Picking service | Event bus | AMQP | publishes `pick.completed` |
  38| | Inventory service | Event bus | AMQP | consumes `pick.completed`, publishes `stock.changed` |
  39| | Slotting service | Event bus | AMQP | consumes `stock.changed` |
  40| | Slotting service | Inventory service | gRPC | stores slot assignments |
  41| 
  42| Slotting service stores its slot assignments through the Inventory service API; it has no database
  43| of its own. The Inventory DB streams to the Reporting replica. No other database is replicated.
  44| 
  45| ### 3.3 Pick flow
  46| 
  47| 1. A floor operator scans a tote with the Handheld app.
  48| 2. The Picking service returns the next pick task.
  49| 3. The Picking service reserves the stock in the Inventory service.
  50| 4. The operator confirms the pick on the Handheld app.
  51| 5. The Label printer bridge prints the shipping label.
  52| 6. The Picking service publishes `pick.completed`, and the Inventory service lowers the stock.
  53| 
  54| ### 3.4 Limits
  55| 
  56| | Subject | Limit |
  57| | :--- | :--- |
  58| | API gateway | a client call times out after 15 s |
  59| | Stock reservation | released after 120 s without a confirmed pick |
  60| | Label printing | retried 3 times |
  61| | Reporting replica | an alert fires when the lag exceeds 30 s |
=== END docs/ARCHITECTURE.md ===
